snippet.title: The Weather Kitchen (Philips CD-i) No Commentary Playthrough
snippet.description:
Playthrough with commentary available here - https://youtu.be/u7Js6k47wx8

Welcome to The Weather Kitchen - a game so rare that only two copies are known to exist. Released for the Philips CD-i in 1995, this educational disc is short on content but more than makes up for it in terms of disturbing imagery. Let's cook up a natural disaster - a great big one!
